Place the quilt in the lower two-thirds, with enough space above for the headline. Set "A SOFT CHAPTER" in slightly irregular handwritten lettering, then "A quiet place between the folds." in smaller handwriting. Include one subtle curved underline. These are the only words.

The image should read first as a real quilt, then reveal a small, comforting illustrated story. Keep the composition rich in tactile detail but organized around one object and one adult. No real brands, logos, watermarks, decorative icons, duplicate figures or invented publication marks. No childlike body proportions. Maintain believable perspective, shared lighting and clear hands holding the book.

A candid, photorealistic street-style photograph of a young East Asian woman crouching beside a massive warm beige limestone wall at a traditional European sidewalk café shortly after rainfall. She wears an oversized light taupe-beige trench coat, faded blue jeans, and a black inner layer. A distressed chocolate-brown leather handbag rests against her raised knees. Her dark hair is loosely tied back with wispy bangs framing her face. One hand, partially concealed by a long black sleeve, rests against her lips and cheek as she gazes thoughtfully toward the lower left. The atmosphere is intimate, nostalgic, quietly melancholic, and effortlessly fashionable, resembling an authentic spontaneous travel snapshot.

IDENTITY REFERENCE

If a model reference is provided, use it for facial identity while following this prompt for the scene, expression, pose, hairstyle, styling, lighting, and composition. Preserve recognizable facial features with natural adaptations to the scene. If no reference is provided, create a new young East Asian woman suited to the scene.

SUBJECT AND EXPRESSION

The woman occupies the lower-right portion of the composition, crouching close to the limestone wall. Her head tilts subtly forward toward her raised hand, and her gaze falls diagonally toward the viewer's left, slightly downward without direct eye contact.

Her expression is calm, reserved, introspective, and faintly melancholic, with relaxed eyelids and naturally closed lips. Her black-sleeved knuckles rest gently against her mouth and cheek.

Natural makeup includes softly defined eyes, delicate eyeliner, muted rosy-brown lips, subtle cheek color, and realistic skin texture.

Her dark espresso-black hair is loosely gathered into a slightly messy low ponytail. Fine, airy bangs fall irregularly across her forehead, while wispy strands frame her temples, cheeks, ears, and neck. Preserve soft volume and natural flyaways.

WARDROBE AND ACCESSORIES

Trench coat: Oversized, lightweight trench-style coat in muted light taupe-beige with a subtle gray undertone. Broad pointed collar, dropped shoulders, long roomy sleeves, wide cuffs, and a loose flowing silhouette. Matte fabric with realistic wrinkles and folds. The front hangs partially open, revealing a black inner layer. Its long hem extends below the knees, with excess fabric pooling naturally on the pavement.

Inner layer: Simple black top with extended sleeves, one partially covering the hand resting against her face.

Jeans: Relaxed medium-blue denim with a softly faded wash, worn-in texture, and natural knee creases. Both bent knees remain prominently visible.

Handbag: Medium-sized, slouchy vintage-style handbag in distressed chocolate-brown leather, positioned directly in front of her raised knees near the lower center. Softly structured rectangular body, rounded corners, two elongated handles, front zippered pocket, small flap details, visible stitching, and understated dark metal hardware with no logo plate or lettering. The aged leather shows natural grain, irregular creases, reddish-brown tonal variations, and worn highlights. The bag rests against her legs, partially concealing her lower body.

A minimal silver ring is visible on her lowered hand.

POSE AND BODY LANGUAGE

She holds a compact, low crouch on damp pavement, with both knees deeply bent and drawn toward her chest.

Her torso leans slightly forward, shoulders gently rounded. One elbow rests near a raised knee while its hand supports her cheek and partially covers her lips. The other arm hangs loosely beside her body, with the hand resting near the pavement and gathered coat fabric.

Her posture feels relaxed, inward-looking, and spontaneous, as though she has paused outside the café. Preserve realistic body compression, balance, and natural clothing folds.

ENVIRONMENT AND SPATIAL LAYOUT

A charming traditional European sidewalk café with limestone architecture, woven rattan furniture, cream canvas parasols, olive-like trees, muted green planters, and rain-darkened pavement.

Right: A massive pale golden-beige limestone wall dominates the upper-right half of the frame, extending vertically beyond the image. Its surface features sandy grain, fine pores, subtle weathering, irregular discoloration, and long horizontal masonry joints. It provides expansive textured negative space above the woman. A recessed stone corner and darker architectural opening appear along the far-right edge.

Left: An empty outdoor café terrace densely arranged with traditional Parisian-style woven rattan chairs and small circular tables. The chairs feature honey-brown bamboo-like frames, curved backs, slender legs, and tightly woven beige-and-olive patterned seats and backrests.

A prominent round café table occupies the middle-left area, surrounded by chairs. Additional furniture overlaps naturally behind it, creating layered depth.

Large cream-colored café parasols stand among the tables. One tall parasol near the left-center is tightly closed, vertically gathered, and secured with a fabric strap. Other cream canvas awnings and open umbrellas extend across the upper background.

Small olive-like trees with narrow gray-green leaves rise between the tables. A large rectangular wooden planter painted muted pastel sage green occupies the lower-left foreground, partially cropped and filled with dense shrubs.

Background: Dark parked cars and a light-colored vehicle appear beyond the terrace, partially obscured by trees and furniture. An ornate pale European building with classical stone details, decorative railings, and plain traditional storefront awnings with no lettering stands across the street. The café terrace remains empty of customers.

WET SURFACES AND MATERIALS

The scene takes place shortly after rainfall.

Dark brown wooden decking beneath the café furniture is damp and subtly glossy, reflecting daylight in irregular streaks.

The foreground consists of dark gray stone pavement with visible slab joints, rough textures, moisture stains, and soft reflective patches extending toward the lower-left corner.

Surfaces appear naturally wet rather than flooded. Preserve believable contact between the woman, handbag, gathered coat fabric, and pavement.

Emphasize tactile contrasts between porous limestone, woven rattan, weathered leather, soft cotton, muted greenery, and rain-darkened stone.

LIGHTING AND COLOR GRADING

The sheltered foreground beside the wall remains darker than the open café background. Soft shadows define her face and clothing without harsh contrast, settling on the right side of her face.

Soft, overcast natural daylight enters from the café terrace on the left.

The woman's face receives gentle upper-left illumination, creating delicate highlights across her forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, and lips. Her dark hair catches restrained natural reflections.

Warm reflected light from the limestone subtly influences her skin and coat, balancing the cooler gray pavement.

The background appears slightly brighter than the subject, reproducing the natural exposure of a spontaneous outdoor photograph. No direct flash or artificial studio lighting.

Use a warm, muted, slightly vintage European travel-photography palette: sandstone beige, pale golden limestone, light gray-taupe, cream canvas, honey-brown rattan, sage green, subdued olive foliage, charcoal-gray pavement, faded blue denim, chocolate-brown leather, and espresso-black hair.

Overall white balance is subtly warm, with yellow-beige highlights and restrained olive-green undertones. Shadows remain neutral to slightly cool, particularly on wet pavement and in sheltered areas.

Colors are moderately desaturated while retaining natural richness. Warm architectural tones contrast softly with cooler pavement and denim.

Maintain gentle contrast, slightly lifted dark tones, soft highlight transitions, realistic skin colors, subtle tonal softness, and fine photographic grain. The grading should evoke an authentic nostalgic travel memory rather than an exaggerated cinematic filter.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION

A candid environmental portrait captured from a standing perspective, with the camera looking slightly downward toward the crouching woman.

Use a moderately wide, natural field of view, preserving substantial architectural and environmental context.

The subject occupies the lower-right quadrant, with her head below the horizontal midpoint. Her compact crouching silhouette extends toward the bottom edge, while the limestone wall creates expansive negative space above her.

The left half contains layered café chairs, circular tables, parasols, greenery, parked cars, and distant European architecture. The sage-green planter is cropped along the left edge. Dark wet pavement fills the lower foreground, leading diagonally toward the café decking.

Preserve realistic perspective, natural proportions, and mild wide-angle spatial depth.

Use a relatively deep depth of field. The woman remains visually prominent, but café furniture, plants, architecture, and background elements stay recognizable.

The framing should feel spontaneous and slightly imperfect, resembling an authentic smartphone or compact-camera travel photograph rather than a staged fashion editorial.

FINAL PHOTOGRAPHIC MOOD

Preserve fine skin texture, loose hair strands, natural fabric creases, aged leather grain, woven rattan patterns, porous limestone, and irregular wet reflections.

The woman's solitary crouching pose contrasts with the empty café terrace and expansive architecture, creating a subtle narrative of peaceful introspection.

Capture the understated elegance of a rainy European afternoon through effortless street styling, nostalgic muted colors, soft natural daylight, tactile realism, and the intimate authenticity of a spontaneous personal photograph.
